tools.name: service_catalog
tools.description: Free: list the paid data services, their prices, the payment network and the receiving wallet.

tools.name: token_report
tools.description: ERC-20 on-chain report (metadata, supply, transfer activity, optional pool depth). Chains: base, base-sepolia, robinhood. Price 0.01 USDC — pay first, then pass payment_signature.

tools.name: contract_dd
tools.description: Due-diligence signals for a token contract: risky selectors found in bytecode, owner and renounced status, transfer activity. Signals to investigate, not a verdict. Price 0.05 USDC.

tools.name: pool_risk
tools.description: Pool depth, implied price and constant-product slippage for a trade size. Price 0.02 USDC.

tools.name: wallet_profile
tools.description: Activity profile for one address on one token: transfers in/out, distinct counterparties, first and last block seen. Price 0.03 USDC.
